newsitem.title: USA: EchoStar holding co to sell $325 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: EchoStar holding co to sell $325 mln debt.

text.p: EchoStar DBS Corp, a holding company of EchoStar Communications Corp, will issue $325 million in five-year senior secured notes next week via a Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette syndicate, buyside sources said.
The notes feature a two-and-a-half year interest reserve, one source said.
Notes must be issued through the holding company to circumvent an indenture of outstanding EchoStar Communications Corp debt that prevents further senior debt issuance, one fund manager said.
EchoStar would neither confirm nor deny the offering.

Sources said EchoStar is seeking financing for additional satellites following the fallout of a planned $1.0 billion investment from News Corp Ltd. Under the terms of the initial plan, News Corp would have provided a $200 million loan for capital buildout.
EchoStar on May 12 said without the News Corp investment it would not be able to fulfill its business plan. A search for additional financing was then initiated, it said.
EchoStar and News Corp have been embroiled in litigation over the matter for more than one month.
